name: Hostaway
positioning: Channel management and automation for growing STR portfolios, with an open marketplace rather than a closed suite.
description: Hostaway provides short-term rental channel management, a unified inbox, automated messaging and task workflows, direct booking sites, payment processing and reporting, with an integration marketplace covering pricing, locks, cleaning and accounting tools.
real_estate_use: Its typical buyer is a manager scaling from twenty to two hundred units who wants to keep their existing pricing and cleaning tools. The open integration approach means the operator assembles a stack — Hostaway for channels and automation, PriceLabs for rates, Turno for cleaning — rather than accepting one vendor's version of each.
features: Channel management across major booking platforms
Automation rules for messaging, pricing and tasks
Direct booking website with payment processing

use_cases.job: Scale a short-term rental portfolio while keeping best-of-breed pricing and cleaning tools
Automate the full guest message sequence across every channel
